fusions.name: Yoked Blow
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 28 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It hits 10% harder for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Swatting Tail
fusions.desc: A swat that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Long Furrow
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Toil

riders.text: the small hurts close on their own
and everything comes round again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 12% faster, from silver your health recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
